doc.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Why he left Vegas
summary: Music, marriage and the changing scene all fell together and he left for New York.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Your departure from the whole Vegas scene came as a result of which? Your desire to change direction musically and do something else or the fact that your marriage was breaking up --
-- or the fact that the music scene was not?
-- everything together. Everything together. It all started falling together.
-- led you to leave the Vegas scene and now think about doing something else?
I left and then I came to New York, right. Uh-huh. [affirmative] Uh-huh.
And now -- now what are you doing?
